course: Core Pure 1 (PMT topic sheets, owner folder Year 1)
cropMethod: Scheme regions run from each "Qn." label to the next label (labels tightened to their own text line); every content box on every scheme page is assigned to exactly one question (asserted). Crops are split only at blank rows or table rules so no crop is taller than it is wide, and each cut leaves at least 20 pt. Figures are 200 dpi crops including their printed captions.

rubric.easy: Routine: a standard result or procedure applied directly, in short structured parts; no insight or choice of method needed.
rubric.medium: Standard methods combined over several steps, or one signposted non-routine step; moderate algebra; guided modelling.
rubric.difficult: Problem-solving: unstructured or multi-concept, the method must be chosen without guidance, or long and delicate algebra, geometry or extended modelling. (The brief calls this level "hard"; Luisa stores it as "difficult".)

rerate.initialAgreement: 6/11 (0.545); all 5 disagreements one level apart, in both directions

resolutions.rule: easy: short structured parts, standard result applied directly
easy: routine procedures, no choice of method
medium: standard methods combined over several steps, all signposted; not unstructured or delicate
easy: a standard divisibility induction applied directly; the index step is the standard one

rerate.finalAgreement: 10/11 (0.91): the reviewer rating was adopted for 4 questions by the rubric; for ch8/q3 the rubric supports the import rating (easy).
rerate.consistencyPass: All 73 rows re-read against the rubric after resolution; no further changes.

mathsReview: An independent agent compared all 73 rendered app questions with the rendered source pages (zooming into maths embedded as images): 0 discrepancies; the source slips recorded below are real and no other slip was repaired. Its scheme sample (14 questions over all 9 chapters, including Ch.6 Q3 and Ch.9 Q10) found every scheme complete with nothing from another question. An OCR scan of all 135 Core Pure 1 scheme pages found one misplaced block (below) and no other appendix or cross-reference.

pure-core-1-ch6.reason: The Ch.6 Matrices PDF places 'Appendix: Alternatives to (b)' (the gas pipeline tunnel, M(100, 200, 100), P(-300, 400, -150)) after Q3's scheme. duplicateRule: The copy keeps a duplicateOf link and neither copy is deleted. A generated exam paper or booklet drops the copy whenever its original is in the pool; a hand-picked selection containing both shows a note.
partMarks: Ch.4 Q4 and Q5 and Ch.8 Q3 and Q4 print only the question total; no part marks were added.
printInspection: Real Chrome PDFs inspected page by page: practice paper one per page and condensed with solutions on and off, and a mixed past-paper + PMT exam paper (no source on question pages; exact source and ID in the scheme). No warnings and no element wider than its page.
